view_mapping.method: World origin fixed from viewport control; independent X/Y scale, no alignment fit per case.

native_profile.capture_condition: Fixed Normal zoom, fresh Draw DOS launch, pointer parked above canvas, 450 ms stable repaint check
native_profile.machine: Tandy 1000 RSX, 386SX at 25 MHz, 4 MiB, internal VGA, COM1 serial mouse

limits: Framebuffer-phase pattern fills and VGA palette conversion. Approximate ellipse, arc and polygon stepping. Strokes are one-pixel solid approximations. Text is omitted. The companion SVG is the separate shared scalable projection.
